source_design.source_weighting: One equal total weight per training species, then equal weight per distinct study-species-site pair within species.

historical_predictor.formula: Mean of four-bioclimate 21ka-versus-0BP standardized Euclidean displacement magnitude across the two original source collection locations; SD on original training plant source endpoint 0BP sites only.
historical_predictor.note: Predictor fraction = weighted residual variation of H after 11 modern and spatial controls divided by total weighted variation of H, fitted only on source TRAIN species. It is NOT genetic explained variance, phenotype rate R², out-of-species trait prediction gain, or evidence of climate-history adaptation.

interpretive_limitations: Only 187 distinct study/species/site-pair geometries remain after collapsing 1561 published effects; 1561 are not independent geographical replicates.

Residual historical signal is concentrated: effective 11.6 training species among 35, single species 20.9% share. Qualification by the prior 5% nonredundancy gate does not establish broadly distributed empirical genetic effects.
The 70 source taxa had already been selected on pre-response site/metadata eligibility; not independent verification of genotypic adaptation.
Original PROCEED genphen=Genetic refers to studies aiming to capture a heritable component (e.g. common gardens or quantitative genetics), not reciprocal-transplant fitness or speciation.
Sampling original study locations with 21ka palaeoclimate is not evidence those lineages occupied those localities during the LGM.

Repeat climate/source numerical identity under pinned environment before considering any one-shot trait-rate endpoint; first source information result is source-only and exploratory relative to older 653-species TTF-Q climate information.
next_gate: Independent exact-source-only replay; then separately preregister endpoint comparability and study/design metadata before any novel genetic-based trait-rate model.
